description: Governs computer vision in Dota AI Coach — extracting information from the player's own screen via Windows Graphics Capture, ROI extraction, preprocessing, recognition, confidence scoring, temporal smoothing, and ObservableState output. Use whenever implementing, modifying, or reviewing screen capture, region-of-interest handling, image recognition for HUD/portrait/scoreboard/minimap elements, or any code that reads pixels from the game client. CV in this project may only read what's actually rendered on screen — never infer hidden information — so this is a fair-play boundary as much as a technical guide; consult it and `dota-fairplay` together before shipping any new CV feature.
